lifestyle-health.image_caption: Researchers have developed deep-learning models that can estimate how quickly individual organs age, revealing that different organs age at different speeds across adulthood.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: The study's findings on lifestyle factors that slow or accelerate aging — including diet, sleep, and exercise patterns — have direct relevance for health-conscious diaspora readers tracking their own biological age.

lifestyle-health.title: Why Every Diabetic Needs Annual Eye Screening — and How AI Is Scaling It in India
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Diabetic retinopathy blinds millions who never see it coming. India's AI-powered MadhuNetrAI app and diaspora specialists are racing to change that.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A retinal scan used to detect diabetic retinopathy. Annual eye screenings can catch the condition early and prevent vision loss in diabetic patients.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asians face elevated diabetes risk and develop Type 2 at younger ages; annual dilated eye exams from diagnosis are critical, and Indian-origin specialists are leading treatment advances in the US.
